GORDON TRAINER’S INITIAL BRIEF
Gordon Trainer, pro se intervenor, on behalf of himself, respectfully submits this initial brief. Gordon Trainer is a landowner to property impacted directly by one of the proposed routes. His item number is 802. 
Gordon Trainer previously submitted testimony and exhibits that were admitted into the record. Gordon Trainer respectfully requests that the Administrative Law Judges consider the admitted testimony and exhibits in their entirety.  
Based upon the evidence admitted into the record, Gordon Trainer opposes the application in its entirety and respectfully recommends denial of the proposed transmission line project. 
As set forth in Gordon Trainer’s testimony and exhibits, the proposed project would negatively affect Intervenor’s property, agricultural activities, existing improvements, future plans for the property, and continued use and enjoyment of the land. Those concerns are fully described in the evidence already admitted into the record. 
In the alternative, should the Commission approve the application despite Intervenors recommendation for denial, Gordon Trainer respectfully requests that the Commission consider the alternate routes identified in his testimony and continue to reject Route A6 for the reasons set forth therein.  

Respectfully Submitted,
/s/ Gordon Trainer
Pro se Intervenor
